title: Aureline locale-pack terminology governance glossary
description: Governed terminology for the critical trust, policy, capability, lifecycle, recovery, evidence, and AI-safety vocabulary that localized surfaces draw from. Each term fixes one canonical meaning so translations cannot fork critical semantics. Host-stable-locked terms are rendered from the host catalog and may never be replaced by a contributed pack; review-governed terms may be translated but must preserve the canonical meaning. This artifact carries governance metadata only: no translated bodies, signing keys, or credentials.

governance_class.description: host_stable_locked: rendered from the host catalog, never replaced or translated by a contributed pack. translatable_with_review: may be translated, but the canonical meaning and severity are fixed and the translation must preserve them under review.

term_key.description: Stable, locale-neutral key surfaces and exports anchor on.

canonical_term.description: Source-language term that fixes the meaning once.

forbidden_to_replace.description: True when a contributed pack may render but never replace this term.

do_not_soften.description: True when a translation may not soften, strengthen, or reorder the term's meaning or severity.

host_catalog_ref.description: Host catalog that owns the canonical vocabulary, for host-stable-locked terms.

host_stable_label_class.description: Maps to the runtime host-stable label class, when one applies.

translation_review_required.description: True when a translation of this term must pass terminology review before shipping.
